cpu-avx512-gemv.cite: DERIVED from measured, llama.cpp discussion #11733: Llama-3.1-70B F16 tg128 x 141.1 GB weights over likwid-load bandwidth, 1 socket: 9374F 176/185.3=95%, 9175F 332/378.3=88%, 9654 309/359.9=86%. cuda-flashdecode.basis: % of HBM peak (H200 measured; upper bracket H100/B200)
cuda-flashdecode.cite: MEASURED, intake-2870 (arXiv 2611.30027): FA4 FP8 decode attention 85-89% of peak at batch>=8 on H200; plain device copy of the same bytes 87-89% on H200 (copy ceiling); ref = 88% midpoint of FA4 FP8 and the copy ceiling. Upper bracket: FlashInfer BF16 decode >90% on H100/B200 (FOSCAR, arXiv 2611.09722, intake-2879). Operator-approved figures.

cuda-flashdecode-q4kv.cite: MEASURED, intake-2870 (arXiv 2611.30027): best 4-bit KV attention kernel 67-75% of peak at batch 32-128 on H200; ref = 71% midpoint of 67-75%. Deployed vLLM NVFP4 only 10-20% on H200. Operator-approved figures. Benchmarks row ak-gvfattn-q4kv-gpu-20261124.

cuda-fused-tail.cite: No per-kernel figure at decode shapes. Large-shape H100 (AutoKernel arXiv:2603.21331 Sec 7.1/Table 4): rmsnorm 83% at 8192x8192, ~51% at 4096^2; softmax ~50%; rotary ~17-18%. Whole-step launch-bound proxy: intake-448 (HazyResearch Megakernels), vLLM/SGLang ~50% of H100 bandwidth, fused megakernel 78%. Ours remains a fixed 35 proxy.

cuda-gemv.cite: No per-kernel %-of-peak for quantized decode GEMV on H100/A100 found. Marlin (arXiv:2408.11743; github IST-DASLab/marlin README) gives only speedup vs FP16 (3.87x ideal to bs 16-32, A10). Brackets, all end-to-end: llama.cpp CUDA ~80% SOL, RTX 5090, gpt-oss-20b MXFP4 (llama.cpp discussion #17621); ExLlamaV2 4.25bpw 75.4% / AutoAWQ-Marlin 28.9% of int4 floor, L4 (arXiv:2605.30571 Table 7); PyTorch bf16 26.9%, H100 (same paper, Table 8).

cuda-moe.batch_note: B=1: 21% best-kernel; compare n=3 MMID at the B=4-8 range
cuda-moe.cite: MEASURED, arXiv:2609.04244 (MonoMoE) Sec 4.3, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-FP8 on H200: MonoMoE 21.20/37.51/49.06/57.99% of peak at B=1/2/4/8 (vLLM Triton baseline 10.62/19.36/30.78/45.07%); Table 1 baseline fused_moe BW 20.0/46.1/62.8/60.1% at BS 1/4/8/16. ref = best published kernel at B=8. Corroboration: Cursor warp-decode, B200 B=32, 58% of measured 6.8 TB/s copy peak.

cuda-scan.cite: No tuned GDN/Mamba decode kernel reports %-of-peak (fla, Mamba2 SSD papers report speedups). Only measured datum: NVLabs PyTorch reference GDN decode, 1 layer hv=32 d=128 FP32 state, H100 285 us/token for 4,194,304 B, i.e. 14.7 GB/s = 0.44% (arXiv:2603.05931 Tables II, IV). Untuned, not a parity ref.
